**sdd/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/design**

**What**: Design for issue #599 (adr-0023-citation-gap). Full file at /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-599/openspec/changes/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/design.md (worktree, branch feat/issue-599-docsadr-adr-0023-is-cited-by-two-plannin).

**Why**: Proposal ruled branch (2) — reword, write no ADR. Measured: nothing the draft proposes has shipped (roles/ absent, VALID_OPS=['init'] at brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs:99). 0023 stays RESERVED for #312.

**Where**: docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md:72 and :93, docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md:114, test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs:145-150.

**Decisions**:
- D1 — Reword only; no ADR written; each line must state draft exists + number reserved + #312 owns it.
- D2 — Safe form is the lowercase draft path `brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md`. CITATION_RE=/ADR-(\d{4})(?!\d)/g is case-sensitive by declared design (limit 3, test lines 34-37). Form proven live and green at docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md:107,198 under the REQUIRED_ROOTS `docs/` surface. Rejected `ADR 0023` / `ADR-23` (dodge the regex, still point at nothing).
- D3 — Exact replacement text per site:
  A (table row, single line): `| M5 | Role-as-port (C) | #312 — owns the decision record; \`0023\` reserved, unpromoted draft at \`brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md\` |`
  B (prose, 3-space continuation indent, ~100 col): `   implementer, not a replacement. #312 · number \`0023\` reserved for it; the only artifact today is` / `   the unpromoted draft \`brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md\`.`
  C (Spanish, neutral, infinitive-led): `- Escribir el ADR del port de roles desde el código ya entregado y promoverlo (\`decisions/\` +` / `  HOME.md): hoy solo existe el draft \`brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md\` y el número \`0023\`` / `  queda reservado para este ticket (#312).` — replaces "Ratificar", which falsely implied the decision was already made.
- D4 — KNOWN_GAPS surgery: delete exactly the two object literals (lines 145-150), end state `const KNOWN_GAPS = Object.freeze([]);`. Do NOT edit the docblock (126-144) — it holds the contract (ticket required, ADR-0018 never baselined), not the inventory. Array must stay declared: 3 call sites depend on it (registry spread line 222, 0018 guard line 346, ticket assertion 353-358).
- D5 — Atomic by construction, read off the code: delete-first reddens the resolution check (rot filter, line 281); reword-first reddens the staleness guard (stale filter, line 335). Corollary: `covers` (line 214) matches a (file, number) PAIR, so rewording only MASTER-PLAN:72 while keeping the entry passes silently — the deletion is what forces both lines.
- D6 — Verification order, red-first: (1) delete KNOWN_GAPS only, run `node --test test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs`, expect failure naming exactly 3 sites (fewer = stale site list, stop); (2) apply the 3 rewords, re-run, 10/10 green; (3) `npm test`; (4) single commit — never land the red split. Optional probe: re-add an entry, staleness guard must redden.
- D7 — Rejected: writing ADR-0023 now (no shipped mechanism to write it from; #590's pattern unavailable); permanent KNOWN_GAPS entry (maintainer ruled reserved-for-#312); new exemption registry or widening UNSCANNED_ROOTS (leaves the reader pointing at nothing; widening also requires deleting the `docs/` REQUIRED_ROOTS entry, which G1 built to make visible); renumbering the draft (breaks archived reservations, e.g. archive/2026-08-01-issue-358-q5-doctrine-tiers/.../HOME-entry-adr-0026.md:24).

**Learned**: openspec/ is in UNSCANNED_ROOTS, so SDD artifacts may carry the uppercase token freely — docs/** may not. Line budget: docs/** is not in brain.config.json governance.ignoreList (**/*.test.mjs is), ~6 counted lines, single PR, no size:exception. brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md stays untouched and remains malformed (two **Status**: lines, rejected by promote-guards.mjs) — that repair belongs to #312.
